//AllowedHosts: Set to '*' intentionally. The k8s ingress (k8s/ingress.yaml) only routes traffic for sendie.curlyquote.com, so it is the real host-filtering layer. Setting an explicit hostname here breaks kubelet liveness/readiness probes which hit /health by pod IP and fail with HTTP 400 from ASP.NET host filtering. Defense-in-depth via this setting is not worth a probe-failure crash loop.
